prompt: Please summarize the Galatians 6:14 from the bible
response: Galatians 6:14 is a verse from the Bible in which the apostle Paul expresses his deep commitment to the cross of Christ. The verse states, "May I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world." This verse emphasizes the transformative power of the cross, indicating that Paul's identity and values are so aligned with the crucifixion of Jesus that he sees himself as separate from the values and ways of the world. It reflects a theme of surrender and dedication to Christ's teachings and sacrifice.
